Sandbox_TheChosenOne_KnoxImmunityChanceP: Percentage chance that the player is naturally immune to the Knox infection.
Sandbox_TheChosenOne_EnableKnoxFever_too: If enabled, immune characters experience Knox fever progression but recover before zombification. If disabled, immune players don't get sick at all.
Sandbox_TheChosenOne_KnoxMaxHealthThresh: When Knox fever is enabled, clear the Knox infection only when the character's health reaches this percentage.
